description: FastAPI router module for handling CRUD operations on 'Profile' entities, including listing, fetching by ID, creating, updating, and deleting profiles.

methods.name: list_profiles( pagination: tuple[int, int] = Depends(pagination_params), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list profiles with optional pagination.

methods.name: get_profile(profile_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific profile by ID.

methods.name: create_profile(payload: ProfileCreate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new profile.

methods.name: update_profile( profile_id: int, payload: ProfileUpdate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session) )
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing profile by ID.

methods.name: delete_profile(profile_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a profile by ID.
